parameters.formTitle: Leftover: invest what you did not spend
parameters.formDescription:
Four short pages: your financial profile, weekly budgets, an investor quiz, and your result.
Educational prototype using simulated (paper) trading. Not investment advice. Projections are illustrative.

values.fieldLabel: Email (it identifies you: use the same one to retake the quiz later)
Emergency fund: how many months of expenses do you have saved?
Any debt with interest above 8% (a credit card balance, for example)?
Account you would hold this in (for your reference only)

options.formDescription: How much you plan to spend each week on everyday, variable things (CAD). Rent, bills and transfers are left out. Every Sunday, whatever you did not spend in a category can be invested, after your cash cushion.
Seven questions about your goals and how you feel about ups and downs. There are no right answers.

parameters.content:
## LO-01 Onboarding Form (spec §7 F1, §10 WF01, §11)
Form URL: `/form/lo-onboarding`. Four pages, then the rows land in `users`, `profiles`, `budgets`.
The email identifies the user: an existing email updates that user (retake the quiz); a new one gets `user_id` = slug of its local part (`test-d@…` → `test-d`), with a hash suffix on collision. `maya` is never touched.
Scoring, tiers, allocation, warnings, explanation fallback: `lib/scoring.mjs` (pasted in the Code nodes).

## Explanation (spec §19.5)
**Explain (LLM)** is disabled until the `LLM` credential exists; disabled, it passes its input through and **Pick explanation** uses the template.
To turn it on: attach the credential and enable this one node. For OpenAI, replace it with the OpenAI node, same name, same prompt expressions. Don't set temperature/top_p/top_k.

## Writes (upsert on the contract keys)
users (user_id) · profiles (user_id) · budgets (user_id + category_key).
A returning user keeps buffer_balance, carries and created_at.
